expected_completion.business_noun: Eligibility only; complete requires authorized relevant evidence and all host Required facts
expected_completion.exhaustive_sources: No exhaustive completion receipt; insufficient/unavailable, never claim corpus completeness
expected_completion.host_confirmed_facts: Only enumerate actually confirmed host facts, retain missing facts; never imply exhaustive corpus access
expected_completion.pinned_source_facts: Same pinned identities, verify every Required fact; missing facts remain partial/unavailable
expected_completion.ambiguous_entity_inventory: Ambiguous breadth; request clarification or unavailable, never silently narrow to one administrator
expected_completion.unbounded_business_rows: This RAG goal cannot attest a complete business-row export; no SQL permission granted
expected_completion.unauthorized_scope_request: No grant from text; trusted scope must reject an out-of-owner Corpus before execution
